cells.content:
## Root Cause & Signals
- **11 of 13 failures are 30s timeouts**, all in `admin/admin.spec.ts` and `auth/profile.spec.ts`. The `get_slowest_tests` action shows these same tests averaging **30.5–31.1s** against Playwright's 30000ms limit — they are failing *at the boundary*, not on assertions.
- The failing run `crun_aaf24792d42fa94b` (10/11 failed, 9.1%) was followed by `crun_7fe8c1ab9cc9d561` (88.9%) and then the suite run at **100%** — so the defect is intermittent load/timing, not a broken feature.
- Lowest health scores track the same cluster: Admin 2FA login **42/100**, Home heading text **73/100**; Shop cart/coupon **98/100** and Home identity **92/100** are stable.

## Coverage & Quality Gaps
- **Requirements: 1 of 2 covered (50%)** — `REQ-2 KAN-1: Checkout flow` (high) and `REQ-1 Shopping Flow` (medium); one is uncovered.
- **Critical priority is the weak spot:** 6 critical cases, only **1 automated** (high: 27/28, medium: 16/16).
- **44 orphan test cases** are not linked to any requirement — this is the main drag on requirement-coverage reporting.
- **Quality score 0 test cases scored** → Quality Score metric pinned at 50.
- **Execution freshness 38/100** — only 19 cases executed in the last 7 days.
- Defects: **1 total, 0 open** (D-1, minor, resolved, KAN-2).
- **API testing: no data** — 0 calls recorded; `api_report` returned an empty history.
